version: g3_body_v3.1 (v3 + QA conditions P2-1/P2-2 and P3 3-7; renders g3_body_v3_1)
source_script: world/vehicles/sedan_body.py + world/vehicles/build_sedan_v2.py (renders: qa_render.py, arch_crops.py, new zebra_render.py) + detail_crops.py (833 px/m A-pillar corner / tail-lamp crops)
coordinate_system: Blender: origin on the ground at the wheelbase centre, +Y front, +Z up, +X right (= dimension-sheet frame). Exported Y-up (export_yup=True), so Godot -Z is the car front.

bounds_m.note: with placeholder wheels; body shell alone z 0.165..1.448. Nose 2.325 / tail -2.475 are on the sheet to the mm.

Body: BlackTrim (window-surround walls, aperture floors and walls)
Glass: BlackTrim (ceramic band, one boundary face row 15-35 mm)

objects_and_insets.Glass: one object, 6 components: windscreen and rear screen 5 mm inboard along the shell normal, 4 side-glass panels 12 mm inboard; side glass trimmed by the raked A-pillar line (belt y 0.82 -> cant y 0.18, now continuous into the cant rail: boundary y falls monotonically 0.653 @ z1.14 -> 0.163 @ z1.38 -> corner at 1.39) and the forward-leaning C-pillar line; windscreen plan line x 0.72 (base) -> 0.56 (header) leaving a 50-80 mm painted A pillar to the side-glass cant edge; rear screen 0.66 -> 0.56. Ceramic band: parallel plane cuts 15 mm inboard of every straight boundary run, faces within 15 mm -> BlackTrim (constant 15 mm strip; 458 faces).
objects_and_insets.BPillar: band y -0.309..-0.226 (83 mm incl. the 14 mm normal inset; cage +-25 mm, subdivision smooths the station loops outward), belt to cant rail, 14 mm inboard, BlackTrim.
objects_and_insets.window_surround: 728 rim edges of the daylight opening extruded inboard (5 mm at the screens, 12 mm at the side glass, 14 mm at the pillar), BlackTrim, sharp edges.

apertures (sheet frame, inset floor on B.headlamp L/R: y 1.84 .. nose, z 0.65..0.80, |x| >= 0.48, wraps the corner onto the nose face; nose-face upper inner edge now at |x| 0.479 (HOOD_X_NOSE 0.46, hood gap ends there); 9 mm floor
apertures (sheet frame, inset floor on B.grille: |x| < 0.48, z 0.56..0.72 on the nose face; 9 mm floor
apertures (sheet frame, inset floor on B.lower_intake: |x| < 0.50, z 0.25..0.39 on the BumperSkirt; 9 mm floor
apertures (sheet frame, inset floor on B.tail_lamp L/R: y -2.011 .. tail (-2.47), z 0.789..0.951, |x| 0.32 .. quarter skin (0.894): wraps the corner onto the quarter like the headlamp; 9 mm floor
apertures (sheet frame, inset floor on B.mirror_pad L/R: |x| > 0.78, y 0.72..0.88, z 0.98..1.03 (sail area ahead of the A-pillar glass line); 2 mm recess

surface_changes_vs_G2_v2p: P2-1: front lower chamfer applied along the corner normal (part of the lift becomes an inward pull in x for |x|/(W/2) > 0.55) - corner rolls, no diagonal fold in clay_front / clay_front_34 / zebra_hood
P2-2: arch-wall foot raised to the sill-bottom height (FLOOR_Z+0.045) and the liner kept 50-90 mm inside the subdivided wall - no tabs below the sill in arch_front_left / arch_rear_left (833 px/m)
P2-3: shoulder line 0.80 (y 2.0) -> 0.83 (y 0, front handle) -> 0.865 (y -1.15, rear handle) -> 0.95 (y -2.0); measured on the mesh at max-x: 0.799 / 0.831 / 0.865 / 0.947
P3-4: nose 2.325 (end stations pinned; the subdivided end sits on the last ring station)
P3-11: all stations now measured from the sheet nose (Y_NOSE), shut lines at y 0.96 / -0.27 / -1.34 exactly
P3-7/8: greenhouse ring parametrisation blended into the hood/trunk layout over the last 0.30 m before the cowl and behind the screen base (no cage twist at the station boundary)
P3-12: trunk lid falls continuously 1.10 -> 1.02 (t^1.2) with a creased lid lip 0.17 m from the tail
hood: power dome, two soft ridges at x = +-0.15, ~7 mm, cowl to 0.3 m behind the nose; hood leading-edge gap moved to y 2.08 and terminated on the headlamp cut
DLO: recessed glass with black window surround, A/B/C pillars as geometry

v3.1: A-pillar glass line continuous to the cant rail (windscreen zone no longer claims the side-glass G1..CANT faces), tail lamps extended onto the quarter, constant 15 mm ceramic band by parallel cuts, aperture floors sunk along smooth shell normals (grille lower edge centre/side 0.5608/0.5591), hood narrowed at the nose so the headlamp inner edge is 0.479, B pillar 83 mm
reference_ids: production/references/dimension_sheet.json (stations, DLO, apertures, handles, shoulder line, b_pillar_y, door edges)

zebra_reflection_strips: zebra_left.png (5 strips along the car, ortho left)
zebra_hood.png (5 strips across the car, front-left above)

known_defects: Rear-door glass top-rear corner: ~50 mm hook where the door-shut groove ends at the cant rail and meets the recessed glass corner (clay_rear_34 x~690-715 y~300-330; mirrored) - unchanged from v3 (P3).
Grille lower edge at the cap pole: 1.7 mm rise (z 0.5608 vs 0.5591) with a faint shading mark at x 0 (clay_front x~590 y~440) - reduced from 4-5 mm.
B-pillar band 83 mm (brief 60-80; cage +-25 mm, station loops smooth outward under subdivision).
Plane cuts leave n-gons on Body/Glass/BumperSkirt before export (export is triangulated); weighted normals with sharp aperture/surround edges - G7 cleanup.
Rear screen 21.7-23 deg (sheet landmarks themselves give 21.7 deg); not changed.
Faint tone break at the C-pillar foot / trunk shut line junction (QA P3-8) - not addressed.
Windscreen/rear-screen recess (5 mm) and side glass (12 mm) are by construction along stored shell normals, not re-measured on the export.
Placeholder wheels/rims remain for proportion; the G4 wheel assembly replaces them.
